from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689749/attempts/31c36fde4a524b3f9529214b2feb9fae/system/state/workspace/programs/task-e3b275c9.py')
code='''def transform(grid):
    sep_r = [i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_c = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(len(grid))}) == 1]
    rb=[-1]+sep_r+[len(grid)]
    cb=[-1]+sep_c+[len(grid[0])]
    out=[]
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        row=[]
        for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
            vals=[grid[r][c] for r in range(rb[ri]+1,rb[ri+1]) for c in range(cb[ci]+1,cb[ci+1])]

            mark=max(rare,key=lambda v:cnt[v]) if rare else bg
            row.append(1 if cnt.get(mark,0)>=2 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out

            from collections import Counter
            cnt=Counter(vals)
            bg=max(cnt, key=cnt.get)
